scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: FlashVector: Agent for Hierarchical Model Serving Stack Optimization
papers.abstract: Optimizes kernels, computation graphs, Triton model server and feature store. Unity production: up to 2x throughput, 1.98x latency speedup, feature store 1.6x throughput.
papers.authors: Qi Wu, Lohan Lemire, Kai Meng, Zhongmou Cai, Raphael Bargues, Petr Zhitnikov, Zeyuan Cao, Yao Wang, Shujun Bian, Wei Chen, Sean Sheng
papers.summary: 推荐系统的服务成本来自内核、计算图、模型服务器和在线特征处理多个层级，单点调优难以覆盖整体瓶颈。FlashVector 用可扩展智能体框架统一优化异构技术栈。在 Unity 广告平台部署后，模型服务器吞吐最高提升至 2 倍、延迟加速最高 1.98 倍，特征存储吞吐最高提升至 1.6 倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索的排序链路同样跨越特征转换、推理框架和服务器，适合借鉴跨层性能诊断与自动调优流程。应先采集端到端剖析数据，再逐层验证优化是否真正改善线上吞吐和尾延迟；文中数字是广告平台的最高收益，迁移到短文本搜索需要独立压测。

papers.title: Deploying RDMA for Distributed Inference and Training At Scale
papers.authors: Yibo Huang, Yi Cui, Yukai Huang, Huaping Zhou, Jiancong Tong, Zhaoyu Wu, Gen Miao, Haoran Wei, Boyan Ding, Zhuo Jiang, Jianxi Ye, Yibo Zhu, Chuanxiong Guo, Yang Xu, Jie Wu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.12815v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. ByteExpress combines an RDMA-aware allocator, zero-copy transfers, QP multiplexing, receive-credit flow control, a software send window, and RPC-assiste
papers.summary: ByteExpress 针对字节跳动参数服务器式训练与推理，将 RDMA 缓冲分配、零拷贝、连接复用、接收信用和软件发送窗口结合，并在传输层之上实现故障恢复。生产推理中，参数拉取平均延迟及 P99 分别下降 35.7% 和 43.7%，CPU 总使用下降 10.69%；训练参数推送 P99 最高下降 74.0%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索的大规模稀疏参数、排序模型和特征服务，网络卸载必须与缓冲生命周期、并发连接及恢复协议一起设计。可先定位参数拉取在请求耗时中的占比，再评估 RDMA 投入；这些收益来自参数服务器架构，不能直接等同于单机向量检索或普通 HTTP 服务的提升。

papers.title: RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.authors: Huihao Jing, Wenbin Hu, Shaojin Chen, Haochen Shi, Haoyu Huang, Sirui Zhang, Yuxuan Liu, Zhongwei Xie, Haoran Li
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18143v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. On five hybrid models, RadixFlow lowers mean
papers.summary: 混合注意力模型中，命中共享前缀并不代表循环状态已经就绪，队首阻塞会留下无法执行的批处理空槽。RadixFlow 将前缀匹配与状态就绪解耦，只局部等待受阻分支，让独立请求继续填充批次。在 5 个混合模型上，平均延迟降低 3%—24%，执行轮次减少 11%—44%，前缀复用率基本不变。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索中的共享提示词和文档前缀可提高缓存命中率，但调度器还必须检查状态依赖是否满足。可借鉴就绪感知遍历，避免单个未就绪分支拖住其他请求；论文在全注意力对照模型上收益很小，实际部署应先确认模型结构，并同时监测批次大小、轮次和真实延迟。

papers.title: FastEEP: Fast Intra-Instance Elastic Scaling for Expert-Parallel MoE Serving
papers.authors: Yunfei Feng, Jingkai He, Shiqi Liu, Cheng Zhang, Dong Du, Erhu Feng
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18451v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large-scale expert parallelism (EP) has become the standard deployment configuration for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models in production. Meanwhile, the highly dynamic nature of LLM workloads requires providers to continuously adjust serving capacity to match fluctuating demand. Scaling MoE serving cannot be efficiently achieved by simply adding or removing serving instances; instead, it often requires resizing the EP group within an existing instance, which we refer to as intra-instance scaling.Existing inference engines primarily rely on instance-level scaling, which destroys and reconstructs entire serving instances, incurring substantial scaling overhead.
  We present FastEEP (Fast Elastic Expert Parallel), a fast intra-instance scaling system for MoE serving based on the principle of Partial Reuse. FastEEP reuses existing runtime state across worker execution, GPU memory, and communication by separating reusable execution structures
papers.summary: FastEEP 解决 MoE 推理实例内部专家并行组扩缩容需要销毁并重建实例的问题。系统将可复用的执行结构与当前并行配置激活的资源分离，在工作进程、GPU 显存和通信层保留昂贵状态，再协调资源回收和重配置。跨模型实验显示，相比基于 vLLM 的现有方式，扩缩容速度提高 4.5—11.7 倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若用 MoE 承担查询理解或答案生成，流量峰谷下的扩容成本会影响容量规划。部分复用提供了比整实例重启更细的弹性路径，但扩容加速并不等于请求吞吐同比增长；落地应检查专家迁移、通信组重建和显存回收是否影响在途请求，并单独测试故障恢复。

papers.title: SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.15186v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region kee
papers.summary: 非前缀文档 KV 缓存带有原先上下文和位置条件，直接拼接容易改变 RAG 答案。SAFE-KV 从选定文档起重新编码因果后缀。在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，直接组合仅保留 HotpotQA-500/2Wiki-500 的 47.2%/37.8% 基准答案，实际后缀转发修复后达到 100.0%/98.4%；单请求 L40S 实验最终仍选择完整预填充。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索会重复使用热门帖子，但复用文档文字与复用其内部状态是两回事。应以完全相同提示词的完整预填充作为正确性参考，验证答案一致率后再谈加速；该研究显示忠实修复可能重算大部分上下文，因此不应把高缓存复用率直接当成端到端收益。

papers.title: Stable Token-level Scheduling for Serverless LLM Inference
papers.authors: Hardi Ashishbhai Desai, Balaji N K, Sourav Kanti Addya
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.17689v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Serverless inference is emerging as an efficient deployment model for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its ability to elastically scale resources, improve GPU utilization through resource sharing, and reduce infrastructure costs. However, existing approaches primarily optimize time to first token (TTFT) while overlooking inter-token latency (ITL), a key determinant of user experience during response generation. We observe that LLM inference comprises a computation-intensive prefill stage and a bandwidth-bound decode stage, where admitting new requests can disrupt ongoing decoding and increase latency. To address this, we propose Token Window Pacing (TWP), a closed-loop scheduling framework that leverages runtime feedback from ITL, queue depth, and workload characteristics to regulate request admission at the token level instead of the batch level. TWP dynamically adjusts a selfregulating token window and incorporates chunk-based prefi
papers.summary: 无服务器推理接纳新请求时，计算密集的预填充会干扰带宽受限的解码。Token Window Pacing 利用运行时的 token 间延迟、排队深度和负载特征，闭环调整 token 窗口，并配合分块预填充。在真实感无服务器负载上，相比 ServerlessLLM 吞吐最高提高 45%，相比传统调度器最高提高 58%，同时改善延迟波动。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的流式答案既要快出首字，也要保持后续输出平稳，可将 token 间延迟作为准入反馈信号。分块预填充有助于隔离新请求对解码的冲击，但应在真实短查询、长文档混合流量下调参，并同时验证 TTFT、P99 和排队时间，避免只优化吞吐而增加等待。

papers.title: FidelityQ: Preserving Predictive Fidelity in Ultra-Low-Bit Language Model Quantization
papers.authors: Yujie Chen, Weiyan Zheng, Yiwu Yao, Tianchi Hu, Bo Wang, Jiyu Guo, Wenzhan Li, Jingcai Guo, Michele Magno, Haotong Qin
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.14934v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Ultra-low-bit scalar quantization offers a regular arithmetic structure for efficient deployment of large language models, but preserving predictive behavior at extreme precision remains challenging: with only a few reconstruction levels, accurate weight representation must translate into consistent predictions from a small calibration set. We propose FidelityQ, a scalar quantization framework that preserves predictive fidelity at weight precisions down to 2 bits. For accurate quantization, we introduce Information-Aligned Analytic Coding (IAC), which shapes each weight row toward a centered symmetric source via randomized Hadamard mixing and fits a mirrored four-level minimum-distortion quantizer to its empirical weights. Every level set in this family decomposes exactly into two sign-valued bases with associated scales, combining source-adaptive reconstruction with lookup-free decoding compatible with scaled integer arithmetic. Our ana
papers.summary: FidelityQ 用随机 Hadamard 混合与四级最小失真标量编码压缩权重，再按教师与学生分歧的重尾程度选择校准样本，只更新量化级别和尺度。在 LLaMA-2-7B 上，W2A16 的 WikiText2 困惑度为 6.62；W2A4KV4 从此前 8.31 改善至 6.96，线性层权重显存相对 FP16 减少 8 倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的查询理解与生成模型可借鉴其低位宽编码和困难样本校准方法，优先覆盖口语、长尾实体及高置信错误。权重显存降低不代表整个服务显存或延迟等比例下降；部署前需验证算子支持、KV 开销，以及量化是否改变相关性判断和答案质量。

papers.title: Lightweight Scheduling Policies for Continuously Batched LLM Serving Across GPU Architectures
papers.authors: Ashman Mehra, Akshan Agarwal, Aryeh Carmi
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.15899v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language model serving is increasingly limited not only by model size and GPU speed, but also by scheduling during autoregressive decoding, where continuous batching interleaves requests at token granularity as sequences arrive and finish. We study whether lightweight scheduling policies can improve latency-throughput tradeoffs without changing model architectures, kernels, or deploying learned schedulers. We implement a Python/PyTorch continuous-batching testbench with real Hugging Face execution and evaluate eight policies across 1,152 GPU-model-scheduler-workload runs using ShareGPT-derived traffic, six Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral models, and Modal L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs. Scheduler choice changes throughput, TTFT, completion latency, and tail behavior under fixed model, GPU, workload, batch size, and prefill budget. Aging shortest-prompt-first is the strongest practical baseline in many L40S and mixed-workload settings, while
papers.summary: 研究以真实 HuggingFace 模型执行构建连续批处理测试台，在 ShareGPT 派生流量、6 个 Qwen/Gemma/Mistral 模型和 L40S/A100/H100 上比较 8 种轻量调度策略，共完成 1,152 组运行。老化最短提示词优先在多个 L40S 和混合负载条件下表现突出；即使知道剩余输出长度，也不能消除批处理和硬件差异。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索请求长度差异明显，调度策略应针对短查询与长上下文混合流量选择。可将带老化机制的短提示词优先作为低成本基线，同时检查长请求是否饥饿；该研究提供跨硬件实验规模和策略结论，摘要未给统一加速比，因此不能宣称所有 GPU 都会获得固定收益。

papers.title: The COUNT: Counting N-grams Unlocks Scaling on Host Memory and Training-Free Adaptation
papers.authors: Ian Magnusson, Noah A. Smith, Pang Wei Koh
papers.abstract: The scaling relationship of compute and performance for language models (LMs) has been extensively studied; more recently, models are being designed to scale memory use, as well. In particular, adding embeddings for n-grams scales memory separately from compute use, because each pass only processes individual embedding rows, which are much smaller than the storage used for the whole embedding table. However, existing methods train embeddings from scratch, which needs expensive GPU memory for fast reading and writing. Meanwhile, the ordinary memory of the host system is cheap and underutilized by these training methods. To scale on host memory, we introduce COUNT (Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers), which builds n-gram embeddings without adding learned parameters by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host. We use the corpus frequencies to weight together the LM's own unembeddings of the next tokens most often following the current n-gram history. At a fixed compute budget,
papers.summary: COUNT 将离线统计的 n-gram 频次存放在主机内存，再对语言模型已有的输出 embedding 按后继词频加权，构造无需新增可学习参数的输入表征。在固定计算预算的 1B 模型预训练中，其验证损失收益可比增加 57% 计算量的模型；推理时还能替换领域计数表，在不训练的情况下适配新任务。
papers.key_insight: 对社区帖子这种领域词汇持续变化的数据，可探索把频次知识放到廉价主机内存，减少 GPU 显存竞争。它提供了模型参数之外的适配通道，但不是开箱即用的召回模型；需要测量主机查表传输开销、计数表更新成本，以及社区长尾词变化是否改善搜索任务。

papers.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
papers.authors: Zefeng He, Yunkai Chai, Xiaoyang Chen, Tong Zhu, Zongliang Wu
papers.abstract: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose LatentLoop, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. We further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence, and share MoE weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their di
papers.summary: LatentLoop 利用共享模块第一次循环与第二次循环贡献不对称的现象，压缩第一次的序列、保留第二次完整分辨率，并用节省的计算扩大隐藏维度。在 1.3B—7B 的 15 种配置中均降低验证负对数似然；拟合到 NLL 1.988 时，预测计算量相对普通 MoE 和循环基线分别节省 19.0% 和 7.9%。
papers.key_insight: 对需要自训小型社区语言模型的团队，计算预算应按不同循环的实际贡献分配，而非机械地重复相同计算。可借鉴先测残差贡献、再调整序列分辨率的流程；文中的节省来自拟合曲线，不能当成线上延迟实测，推理端还需验证序列压缩与注意力实现成本。
